section.label: Selected work
section.title: Systems that create leverage.
section.intro: The common thread is bigger than UI: define the boundary, make change safe, and leave behind a path other engineers can follow.

items.title: Move the system without moving the risk.
items.summary: Designed a controlled path for moving frontend API traffic between versions while preserving day-to-day customer behavior. Feature flags made the cutover granular, reversible, and observable.

details.label: The tension
details.copy: Multiple teams needed to modernize shared integrations without turning a version change into a coordinated release event.

details.label: The approach
details.copy: Separated compatibility logic, introduced per-path controls, and backed the migration with focused testing and production-safe rollout steps.

details.label: The leverage
details.copy: Converted the successful implementation into shared utilities and a repeatable method that other engineers and teams could adopt.

items.title: One experience. Many product contexts.
items.summary: Built a reusable micro-frontend module whose behavior is driven through deliberate prop contracts. Consuming teams keep ownership of their data while the experience remains consistent.

details.label: The tension
details.copy: A useful product experience needed to appear in different applications, each with its own endpoint, data ownership, and release rhythm.

details.label: The approach
details.copy: Kept the module presentation-focused, defined a stable interface, and moved environment-specific data concerns to consuming teams.

details.label: The leverage
details.copy: Reduced duplicated UI logic and created a cleaner boundary between shared product behavior and team-owned integrations.

items.title: Rebuild the product, not just the interface.
items.summary: Reworked a WordPress-based fitness streaming and scheduling service into a modern React experience, then designed and built its companion mobile application for iOS and Android.

details.label: The tension
details.copy: A growing 50,000+ user service needed a more capable product foundation across streaming, scheduling, and mobile.

details.label: The approach
details.copy: Rebuilt the web experience in React, assessed product and UX feasibility, and carried the system into React Native with in-app purchases.

details.label: The leverage
details.copy: Created a consistent cross-platform experience and a foundation the team could continue evolving through new feature work.
